The hypotenuse joins (25, 0) and (0, 35). Its equation is

$$\frac{x}{25} + \frac{y}{35} = 1 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad 7x + 5y = 175.$$

A lattice point is **strictly inside** the triangle exactly when $x > 0$, $y > 0$, and $7x + 5y < 175$.

## A Symmetry Count

Consider the rectangle of lattice points
$$R = \{(x,y) : 1 \le x \le 24,\; 1 \le y \le 34\},$$
which contains $24 \times 34 = 816$ lattice points. Every point of $R$ is either strictly inside the triangle ($7x+5y < 175$) or on/above the hypotenuse ($7x+5y \ge 175$).

Now reflect through the center of the rectangle:
$$(x, y) \mapsto (25 - x,\; 35 - y).$$
This is an involution on $R$ (applying it twice returns the original point), so it partitions $R$ into pairs. For the image point:
$$7(25-x) + 5(35-y) = 175 + 175 - (7x + 5y) = 350 - (7x+5y).$$

So if $7x + 5y < 175$ (inside), then $350 - (7x+5y) > 175$, meaning the partner point is on the other side of the hypotenuse. The reflection pairs each point inside the triangle with a point on the opposite side of the hypotenuse, so the inside points and outside points of $R$ are matched one-to-one. $$\frac{816}{2} = 408.$$
